description: This source file contains extension methods and utility functions for working with relational database operations in the Orleans framework, specifically for converting CLR types to database types, creating and adding parameters, retrieving data from IDataRecord and DbDataReader, reflection-based parameter handling, and record-to-object mapping.

classes.name: DbExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for database command creation, parameter handling, data retrieval, reflection-based parameter assignment, and object mapping from IDataRecord.

methods.name: CreateParameter
methods.description: Creates a new SQL parameter with specified name, value, direction, size, and database type.

methods.name: AddParameter
methods.description: Adds a new SQL parameter to the command with specified name, value, direction, size, and database type.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a value from IDataRecord, returning a default if the value is DBNull.

methods.name: GetDateTimeValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime? value from IDataRecord, returning a default if the value is DBNull, and ensuring UTC kind.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a strongly typed value from IDataRecord by field name.

methods.name: GetDateTimeValue
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime value from IDataRecord by field name, specifying kind as UTC.

methods.name: GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an int value from IDataRecord by field name.

methods.name: GetInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a long value from IDataRecord by field name, handling differing underlying types.

methods.name: GetNullableInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a nullable int value from IDataRecord by field name.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value of type TValue from DbDataReader by field name.

methods.name: ReflectionParameterProvider
methods.description: Uses reflection to set command parameters based on properties of a parameters object.

methods.name: ReflectionSelector
methods.description: Creates an object of a specified type from IDataRecord by mapping record fields to object properties.
